inline.当前没有船坞服务工程。战损舰会在返航后进入真实维修流程。: No dock-service project is active. Damaged ships enter the real repair workflow after returning.
inline.所有容量扩建都会进入统一建设队列；四类仓储互不转换。: Every capacity expansion enters the shared construction queue; the four storage classes are not interchangeable.
inline.当前没有在途运输: There are no shipments in transit.
inline.核心玩法实验室已启动。所有画面均由 Godot 控件生成，不使用 UI 图片。: Core gameplay lab started. Every screen is rendered with native Godot controls.
inline.轨道节点来自真实地点状态；虚线表示内容定义的物流走廊，未知地点不可操作。: Orbital nodes reflect real location state. Dashed links are defined logistics corridors; unknown locations cannot be operated.
inline.当前勘测层级没有可公开的资源情报。: No resource intelligence is available at the current survey level.
inline.请先从星系地图选择已知地点。: Select a known location on the system map first.
inline.从近地采矿开始，逐步建立可持续的地球工业与远征能力。: Begin with near-Earth mining, then build sustainable industry and expedition capability.
inline.将装备采矿模块的飞船编入采矿舰队，建立稳定原料来源。: Assign ships with mining equipment to the mining fleet and establish a stable raw-material supply.
inline.研究容量是持续流量；项目阶段直接占用材料、制造、能源、设施、物流与真实舰船测试。: Research capacity is a continuous flow. Program phases directly consume materials, manufacturing, power, facilities, logistics, and real ship tests.
inline.管理永久舰船实体、前列 / 中列 / 后列编队、补给、改装、建造和生命周期。: Manage persistent ship assets, formations, supplies, configurations, construction, and service life.
inline.远征需要专门调配的舰船、补给计划以及满足路线需求的战斗与航行能力。: Expeditions require assigned ships, supply plans, and route-specific combat and travel capability.
inline.工业配方占用对应设施；大型设施进入独立的建造队列。: Production methods occupy compatible facilities; major facilities use a separate construction queue.
inline.库存状态由实际生产、持续需求、项目承诺、运输与分级仓储自动计算；无需逐商品设置目: Inventory state is calculated from real production, continuous demand, committed projects, transport, and storage classes. Per-item stock targets and production percentages are unnecessary.
inline.当前地点尚无库存流或登记需求。: This location has no inventory flow or registered demand yet.
inline.输入目标产品吞吐（单位/小时）。规划器只做 BOM 展开、Factory/Dev: Enter target product throughput per hour. The planner expands the BOM and calculates factories, devices, power, storage, logistics, and bottlenecks without changing the economy.
inline.自动化只调用正常暂停/恢复、路线策略和项目优先级事务；不会创建资源或擅自扩建。规: Automation only invokes normal pause/resume, route-policy, and project-priority transactions. It cannot create resources or expand without authorization. Rules retain trigger snapshots, cooldowns, hysteresis, and manual locks.
inline.授权满仓暂停/80%恢复: Authorize pause at full / resume at 80%
inline.唯一太阳系工业终局。八个阶段分别调用真实勘测、库存、物流、建设、能源、散热与维护: The single-system industrial endgame. Eight phases use real surveying, inventory, logistics, construction, power, cooling, and maintenance systems.
inline.当前内容没有定义终局工程。: No endgame project is defined in the current content.
inline.先完成恒星能源巨构计划，再用勘测舰将至少一个候选位置推进到深度勘测。区位差异来自: Complete the Stellar Energy Megastructure Program, then deep-survey at least one candidate site with a survey vessel. Site differences come from real solar flux, cooling, maintenance, and transport lead time.
inline.恒星能源系统已完成调试并投入运行。: The Stellar Energy System has completed commissioning and is operational.
inline.初始采矿配置缺失。请点击“重开”生成新的采矿优先存档。: The initial mining loadout is missing. Restart to generate a new mining-first save.
inline.到“舰队”把初始勘探船调入采矿舰队。: Move the initial survey vessel into the mining fleet on the Fleet page.
inline.到“前线作业”启动近地永久采集点。: Start the permanent near-Earth extraction site from Frontier Operations.
inline.工程制造中心一次只能运行一种配方；分离或精炼完成后先停止，再切换下一项。: The engineering center runs one method at a time. Stop separation or refining before switching methods.
inline.开始组装结构框架；完成一套后停止重复生产。: assemble one structural frame, then stop repeat production.
inline.轨道铸造厂已进入建造队列: The Orbital Foundry is in the construction queue
inline.若显示受阻，先到“生产配方”补齐缺口；建造会自动继续。: If blocked, replenish the shortage under Production Methods; construction resumes automatically.
inline.保留刚做好的结构框架，停止框架重复生产，继续分离并精炼铁锭。: Keep the completed frame, stop repeat frame production, and continue separating and refining iron.
inline.点击“前往下一步”，将在“设施建设”中直接看到建造按钮。: Use Go to next step to open its construction action directly.
inline.建设电子设施和研究中心，开启科研链路。: Build the electronics facility and research center to open the research loop.
